name: bmad-governance-kit
description: Scaffold and operate a durable four-pillar governance layer on any BMAD-planned project — a registry (narrative ROADMAP + release-calendar.yaml as the single structured feature⇄FR join, written via calendar-ops.py and schema-validated), an append-only decision log, an architecture spine with anchored/movable tags, and a self-describing constitution — plus ten commands (scaffold + intake, spec, feature-intake, decision-record, tech-scout, governance-check, epics-projection, test-strategy, fix) that keep it drift-free. Ships faithful pillar templates, the calendar tooling, controlled vocabularies, and an operating contract.
